description: This file defines the frontend user interface for a database viewer web application, including layout, styles, and scripting to load and display database, table, and data information dynamically.
external_methods: fetch (used in script to retrieve data from API endpoints)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, triggers reload of database data.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database node in the sidebar, loads tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a selected database from API.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for displaying table data with scrolling and expandable cells.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling long text, nulls, and objects.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for longer data or objects.
